overview.description: Gibson Assembly replaces digest+ligation with a single isothermal reaction that joins fragments via homologous overlapping ends - reportedly up to 6 at once. Most of the work is primer design for scarless overlaps, so revise that first.
objectives: assemble multiple fragments in one isothermal reaction
decide when to switch from RE digest to single-step cloning

steps.intro: Gibson Assembly replaces digest+ligation with a single isothermal reaction that joins fragments via homologous overlapping ends - reportedly up to 6 at once. Most of the work is primer design for scarless overlaps, so revise that first.

instructions.title: Design overlaps
instructions.description: Design ~20-40 bp homologous overlaps between adjacent fragments using your assembly wizard.

instructions.title: Amplify fragments
instructions.description: PCR each fragment with the overlap-adding primers; gel-confirm sizes.

instructions.title: Assemble
instructions.description: Combine fragments with the master mix and incubate at 50C; transform directly.

submission.description: Assemble a multi-fragment construct by Gibson and confirm it by colony PCR or sequencing.
